profiles.nativeOtClientV8Detail: experimental 740 login, character selection, map, movement, shared-player visibility, bounded player-vitals updates, and a parser-shaped empty Quest Log acknowledgement. The player-stats record has parser-shaped 16-bit level and soul fields, but unmodified-client confirmation remains required
profiles.runtimeItemsAndInventoryDetail: bounded item/equipment/container core, SQLite equipment/container persistence, native-session hydration, catalog-validated classic-740 initial equipment delivery, and an operator command for atomic complete-item transfer from one equipment slot into one already owned bounded container; no native live inventory updates, map-ground transfer, recursive nesting, stack splitting, container windows, or item actions
profiles.playerStateDetail: persisted health, mana, capacity, and magic level feed a parser-shaped classic 740 HUD record with a 16-bit level and bounded soul byte. A shared-world vocation level-up advances the stats epoch, then the existing native refresh rehydrates authoritative level, experience, and vitals before encoding the frame. There is no native gameplay experience source yet, and unmodified-client confirmation remains required
profiles.playerPositionDetail: authoritative native movement persists SQLite position and orderly plus abrupt-disconnect native-session relog regressions restore the saved tile. Unmodified-client confirmation remains required
profiles.playerOutfitDetail: schema-v11 persists accepted classic-740 look type and color values, then hydrates them after map initialization with a configured look-type fallback for legacy or out-of-range records. A native 0xD2 request receives a classic 0xC8 current-outfit plus one-byte inclusive start/end look-type range. Operators may set otclientV8OutfitFirstLookType and otclientV8OutfitLastLookType; both must fit the classic byte form and contain the configured current look type, while zero values preserve the current-look default for existing worlds. A concrete ChangeOutfit request inside that range persists and echoes the selected appearance; an out-of-range request retains the current stored appearance. No newer outfit-list, addon, or mount fields are emitted. Asset validation, addons, mounts, and unmodified-client confirmation remain deferred
profiles.lifecycleDetail: server-side death, temple respawn, and fixed-loss foundations plus schema-v9 persisted dead/respawn/loss state and strict native hydration; client death screens, automatic timers, teleport packets, default-loss formula, and blessings/promotions remain deferred
profiles.progressionDetail: typed seven-skill levels/percentages and numeric vocation identity are authoritative, SQLite-persisted, locally provisionable, and delivered to the selected native 740 path. Operator-owned TFS-style vocations.xml supplies online health/mana regeneration intervals, skill multipliers, and parsed gainhp, gainmana, and gaincap metadata; bounded data/XML/stages.xml plus rateExp drive deterministic authoritative operator experience awards with SQLite persistence, and existing experience awards and loss resolve levels through a checked integer classic cumulative threshold. When the stable CLI finds a matching parsed vocation and a positive level increase, FE atomically persists scaled gains to current/max health, current/max mana, and capacity; absent metadata or no level increase leaves vitals unchanged. The matching shared-world host transition advances the profile-gated stats-refresh epoch and rehydrates the next 740 frame from authoritative level, experience, and vitals, but no native gameplay experience source or real-client confirmation exists yet. Each successful fixed selected-player melee hit can award one configured fist try with exact persisted counters. Hydrated bounded poison/burning/energy damage schedules advance on the native heartbeat with persisted vitals, schema-v10 restores each validated elapsed interval remainder across restart, and lethal bounded condition damage activates the existing persisted server-side death state only at a validated assigned town temple. Promotion, weapon/spell formulas, combat/quest/monster reward sources, condition effect packets, client death screens/timers/respawn packets, soul, and full TFS-compatible advancement transactions remain deferred
profiles.combatDetail: typed physical adjacent-melee events use bounded damage, deterministic per-player server-tick cooldowns, profile-neutral flat physical mitigation, and an optional scriptless FE declarative weapon catalog. On the current native selected-melee path, only a server-owned matching right-hand item may select a catalog weapon; otherwise no catalog event is created. Separately, an active adjacent selected static target receives fixed 10-percentage-point damage no more than once per authoritative world tick through the same per-player combat cooldown; this path has no player-vital persistence, weapon catalog, mitigation, weapon timing, or reward. A typed spell-cast foundation atomically enforces nonzero bounded mana costs and server-tick cooldowns; an optional declarative spell catalog may construct those events from ID, mana cost, and interval, is retained as immutable native-host configuration, and can be resolved through a synchronized server-only host helper. No spell layer is profile-gated, persistent, or client-routable. TFS Lua weapon scripts, legacy XML formula semantics, map use, client weapon-use packets, armor, shielding, spell names/words/targets/formulas/effects/packets, ranged delivery, resistance, PvP, automatic attacks, and client combat effects remain deferred
profiles.mapItemUseDetail: typed server-side validation accepts only same-tile or adjacent use of an exact top-level authoritative map item stack and returns immutable metadata without mutation; the same validation is available through synchronized host state. Action execution, doors, switches, containers, charges, Lua, persistence, and client item-use packets remain deferred
profiles.equipmentBootstrapDetail: catalog-mapped persisted equipment is emitted at native 740 login in deterministic multi-slot order. Extended diagnostics report the count of omitted unmapped items without packet bodies; live inventory updates and container windows remain deferred
profiles.containerBootstrapDetail: top-level persisted containers are emitted at native 740 login only when the container and every contained item have validated presentation mappings. Nested or incomplete-mapping windows are omitted; container actions, live updates, and real-client confirmation remain deferred
profiles.questLogDetail: the native 740 request is decoded and receives a parser-shaped empty quest count response; quest storage, mission lines, scripting, gameplay semantics, and unmodified-client confirmation remain deferred
profiles.creaturesDetail: catalog-derived static spawn representation, native visibility, bounded authoritative 0–100% display health delivered on login and visibility refresh, optional deterministic movement, caller-triggered reactivation, propagated legacy per-spawn intervals for deterministic due-reactivation at an unoccupied spawn position, and native target selection of active authoritative static IDs. An external health value of zero remains display-only and does not deactivate the entity; however, a real adjacent selected static-melee hit that reaches zero deactivates the entity, clears its target intent, removes it from active visibility, and lets the existing reactivation policy later restore its configured spawn percentage. One native game-host heartbeat advances shared-world tick, evaluates due reactivation, and can attempt fixed 10-point static damage; client sessions no longer advance shared time. The visibility epoch changes only after real damage, deactivation, health update, or reactivation. AI, creature formulas/mitigation, loot, corpses, scripts, rewards, persistent monster state, broader-profile coverage, end-to-end service lifecycle testing, and real-client observation remain deferred

profiles.nativeOtClientV8Detail: explicit profile foundation recognizes that classic 8.0 requires RSA/XTEA transport, includes a bounded outbound-only opaque XTEA envelope primitive, and can extract only the marker plus four XTEA words from an already decrypted fixed block for future parser-backed work. Native enablement remains refused: there is no client-input decryption, credential/login/game parser, listener, packet-layout claim, or client interoperability claim
